gitUrl.title: Git repository URL
gitUrl.description: URL of a public git repository to clone and scan (e.g. https://github.com/org/repo.git). Takes precedence over 'path'.

gitBranch.title: Git branch
gitBranch.description: Optional branch/tag to clone. Defaults to the repository's default branch.

path.title: Scan path
path.description: Directory or file to scan inside the Actor. Used only when no Git URL is provided.

openapi.title: OpenAPI spec
openapi.description: Path, URL, or raw JSON of the production openapi.json to compare against.

since.title: Git window
since.description: Only treat endpoints introduced in this window as new (e.g. '1 week ago', 'origin/main').

strict.title: Strict
strict.description: Mark the run as failed if shadow/unauthenticated endpoints are found.
